method: Inclusion is every species printed under the Erinaceidae heading on the 2011 Wayback SANParks KNP mammal checklist PDF (1 species). English and Afrikaans names, and species order, are taken from that PDF. Scientific names are the 2011 names unless an iNaturalist taxon record cited in remaps gives a current name. Research-grade counts are for iNaturalist place_id 69020. iNaturalist-only erinaceids are in candidates, not species. The PDF was fetched to a temporary path for text extraction and was not copied into this project.

gaps: Live SANParks checklist HTML and PDF were not fetched in this session (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403). Inclusion is the 2011 Wayback PDF only, and has not been compared with the live 147–148 figure.
iNaturalist checklist 8810 was not fetched (Phase 1 recorded HTTP 403/401).

Atelerix frontalis is on the official list but has 0 research-grade iNaturalist observations in place 69020 and is absent from the place Erinaceidae taxonomy tree (no observations of any grade). Absence of an iNat record was not treated as absence from KNP.
The 2011 list is already at species rank, so the taxon was stored as Atelerix frontalis, not as a subspecies, even though Southern Hedgehog is the preferred name of A. f. frontalis.

No rare, reintroduced, or introduced flags are recorded for official Erinaceidae species: the 2011 PDF does not mark any of them with an asterisk or other status note (asterisks on that list are only for house mouse and house/black rat under Muridae).
The current live official list, Skinner & Chimimba, and Stuart's guide were not available to corroborate remaps or flags.
